The occupying process was still alive after the refusal (Get-Process 6192 => Unity), so the tool never closes a user Unity. The review record was untouched by the refusal (status running, runs=1, activeRunToken=null). Post-failure unity-review lease recovery is proven by the same review later finishing from its recorded run, and dead leases are reclaimed only when the lease payload names that review.
